description: Search the ainews feed for items relevant to what your agent is about to do — technology, compliance, and security news for AI agents — ranked by relevance to your natural-language query. Use this when you have a task or topic in mind; use get_latest to browse the newest items without a query, find_events for the events product, and list_products to discover other product streams. Read-only: returns public feed data and needs no API key.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

product.description: Optional product stream to read (default ainews).

query.description: Natural language description of what the agent is doing.

tags.description: Optional tag filters applied to feed search.

name: query_security_feed

summary.description: Short summary, or null when the item has not been enriched yet.

title: Query Security Feed
